description: This file defines the RetrievePolicyId class, which represents a command in the Eclipse Ditto framework to retrieve the Policy ID of a specified Thing based on its ID. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, JSON strings, or directly via ThingId, and overrides serialization and equality methods.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyId
classes.description: A command class used to retrieve the Policy ID of a Thing identified by its ID within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.description: Creates a RetrievePolicyId instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.description: Adds the payload data (thing ID) to the JSON object builder based on the schema version.

methods.description: Returns a new instance of RetrievePolicyId with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hash code based on super class and internal thingId.
